svg.aria-label: Pendulum with friction b = 0.4. Grey curves: level sets of the energy V = (1 − cos x1) + x2 squared / 2. Its derivative is −b x2 squared, which is zero on the whole x1 axis (orange), so V alone only proves stability. A trajectory can touch the axis but cannot stay there unless it is at an equilibrium, so by LaSalle it converges to the origin
